Episode 177. Yona, Yona, Yona... (1)
On May 6, 1803, we received a contact from Nameless Assassins saying he had found traces of Yona.
Fortunately, Yona had not left Akin until then, and her location was also far from the civilian houses and the city.
Upon receiving the message, Jin immediately boarded the Red Owl with Hedo and Bale, as well as Bianca Caligo and Ranke Haloviche (they came to ask why they did not bring Bale earlier).
"Jin... Runcandel... Why are we...?"
A hint of surprise showed through Bianca's slow voice. Ranke didn't yell out due to fear of Jin, but he wore a very unhappy face.
"Unfortunately, your duke has made a deal with me. In exchange for letting Orgal meet Bale, he promised to absolutely protect Sandra and Lord Hedo."
"Ah... Protection. But... He didn't say absolute..."
"If you don't want to, you can go back now. But that would mean our deal is off."
When Bianca wrung her hair as if she was frustrated, Ranke finally stood up and frowned.
"Ah, really! That's too much. Are we your slaves? If you want protection, be quiet, and asking us to be responsible for you inviting unnecessary danger?"
"Ranke Haloviche, it seems like you didn't get enough of a beating last time. You seem brave to make such a statement."

"Eike! Though I did lose to you once. I am the eldest son of the great demon world's fourth ducal house of Haloviche, ruler of the northern demon world and its creatures, and owner of Mount Tna and Mount Carrion! I don't give up my pride in the face of power!"
"Is that so?"
"Ra, Ranke."
"This is clearly an excessive and unreasonable demand. Bianca Caligo, don't just stutter like a fool. This is a matter of our four great ducal houses' honor!"
"Honor..."

"Alright, honor. You spoke well. If helping me as per our deal is so distasteful to you, how about this? Ranke, if it wasn't for me in the Caldron snowfield, you would have been finished. Who was it that rescued you when you were lying down like a rag from exhaustion?"
"It was you!"
"If you know, keep quiet and cooperate. Isn't it honorable to help a benefactor?"
"The benefactor can freeze to death, the reason we went to the Caldron snowfield was because of you!"

"That was a necessary task for the great cause of the decisive battle with Rosa. It was not merely my personal affair, it was right for all temporary allies to step forward. The same goes for now. Yona is regarded as a god among the Salsoo. Of course, she will be of great help when we have the decisive battle with Rosa, right?"
"Don't nod as if you're convinced, Bianca. Okay, Jin Runcandel. If this is a temporary alliance, why is Gifel missing? Is it too cumbersome to call that muscle mass? Even if it's for a great cause?"

"Gifel is providing the venue. If you don't like it, you can leave. Go back and explain the situation to your leader, he will probably commend you. And in my opinion, you keep grumbling not only because you hate the work but also because you're afraid of Sister Yona."
"What did you say?"
"If the opponent can kill you before you even realize it, of course it can be scary."
"Ha, alright. After defeating me, you seem to belittle me, prove it today. This Ranke is strong and useful. But after today, be aware that I have no intention of being played by your pranks."
"Alright, alright, very impressive."
Ranke didn't back down due to his pride, and Bianca seemed to understand why she was dragged along.
'They are quite easy to handle.'
It was enough to wonder if all demons were this stupid, and Hedo seemed to have similar thoughts.
However, despite their pitiful intelligence, the reason why people like Bianca and Ranke were respected in the demon world was that they were overwhelmingly strong enough to surpass it.
Anyway, since he was able to bring even the strongest demons, Jin felt much more at ease.
Jin, Hedo, Bale, Bianca, Ranke, and even the top assassins like Owl and Nameless Assassins.
In fact, with this kind of party, there were hardly any beings in the world that they couldn't handle. Except for Chiron and the monstrous Rosa, there was no one who could handle them all alone.
As always, the Red Owl took them to the forest of Akin in an instant.
"You're here, 12th flagbearer. Quite... unique and sturdy combination."
Owl didn't know Bale's identity and why Kinzelo came along. When Jin explained, he nodded as if very satisfied.
"Even if Yona has become stronger due to her soul's rampage, it should be fine."
If the goal was to kill Yona, Jin alone would have been enough, but restraining required more than twice the power. Not only was she strong, but she also had special abilities.
Even in this regard, the party led by Jin was not lacking at all.

"However, if the situation drags on, Gifel will definitely come. Then Lord Hedo's betrayal could become a problem, and Gifel might interfere... well, it doesn't matter. In the face of the decisive battle with Rosa, he won't be able to wage war with those of us who are here. Especially since Kelliark is not in a perfect state either."

"That's correct, Lord Owl. I've already sent a letter to Gifel about this situation. It should have arrived by now. It would be better for them to cooperate to get Sister Yona caught before the damage to their territory gets bigger. Even if it's unfair and infuriating."
"That's something that can only be said if you have a thick enough face.
Also, it's a statement that could only be made by someone who had the power to handle this level of absurdity.
Owul suddenly felt that Jin, who stood before him, had become a figure who was in no way inferior to the world's apexes. In just a few years, Jin had become a real big shot.
'Plus, he's reached a higher level than when I saw him at Hairan's second star...'
Owul looked at Bale.
"Did you break through another wall because of meeting Bale?"
"Bale played a part, but it was mostly due to Rosa. She was becoming complete faster than I was becoming stronger."
During his fight with Bale, Rosa only briefly looked down at Jin through Paddle's eyes, but that alone made Jin clearly feel her power. She was definitely going beyond Orgal's prediction.
"...That's a horrifying story. That's why even your thousand-year-old enemies are combining their power."
Owul pointed at the forest spread out in the distance.

"Yona is somewhere in that forest right now. There have been several battles, but we haven't been able to break through the line. Or... I have a feeling she's been waiting for the best time to kill us all at once. Every time there's a battle, rather than getting tired, her senses seem to become sharper."
In the last battle, Owul and Bezen encountered Yona at the same time, and Bezen nearly died from a single strike.
"Then we should just burn the entire forest to find her."
Bale said.
"Bale, doing that would inevitably lead to civilian casualties. Have you forgotten the lady's orders?"
When Hedo answered, Bale narrowed his brows in annoyance. He wanted to yell at him to shut up and leave him alone, but Sandra's orders also included treating Hedo well.

"I think it would be best if only Hedo, Owul, and I go in for the search. The rest of the team should wait at key points around the perimeter and immediately enter the designated location when the flare goes off. If Yona shows signs of trying to flee once she knows we've entered, Bale will be able to pursue her."
When Bale unleashed his power, rings formed above his head, wings on his back, and golden energy overflowed. He could fly faster than a hawk.

"I think that's a good idea. Either way, the assassins on the perimeter also have flares, so it should be easy to join from any direction. And Bale... it would be nice if you could also play the role of a communication network. Your mobility should be superior."
"Ha, ordering me?"
"Bale, just follow. Do I always have to tell you one more time?"
"Tsk!"
So the group dispersed, and Jin, Hedo, and Owul entered the forest.
Unlike the others, as soon as Jin entered the forest, he felt Yona's faint spirit energy left in various places.
"The remaining spirit energy is too weak and chaotic, but I think we can find Yona if we read it well."
"Do you mean you can feel it?"
"Yes, ever since I developed a heightened sense for chaos, it's been possible, Owul. I will infer the general course, so please advise me whenever I find it difficult to decide."
As the search for Yona began in earnest, he barely managed to keep his dizzying heart at bay.
If Yona had already reached an irretrievable situation, there was no other way than to suppress her and bring her back.
'No, she is doing well. The fact that she hasn't killed any civilians so far is proof that she is resisting. If we don't lose her here, she can definitely come back...'
When the search had been ongoing for a few hours, Jin suddenly stopped and looked around. His face clearly showed signs of confusion.
"12th, is something wrong?"
"...Owul, the types of spirit energy have suddenly increased."
"What?"
"It means that there's more than one being using spirit energy in this forest, not just Yona."
"That can't be. The perimeter has been maintained since you met her at Hairan's second star."
"Isn't it possible that someone breached the perimeter and entered the forest? Or there was another chaos user in the forest other than Yona from the beginning."

"The former is completely impossible. The perimeter includes me and the top assassins, so while breaking through by force may be possible, infiltration is absolutely impossible. Unless someone else exists with abilities on par with Yona or me. The latter is... wait, could it be?"
Owul's eyes widened as if he suddenly thought of something. Jin was thinking the same thing.
"It could be possible if it's a fake Yona. Maybe we've been fighting a fake Yona all this time."
"The new spirit energy I found has a very subtle difference from what I felt before. The fake I encountered in Hairan has infiltrated the forest."
That would mean the fake Yona was in the forest before Mumei, or she had breached the perimeter and infiltrated using her own abilities or the prophet's den.
In other words, there could be several Yonas in the forest, including the real and the fake.
And there were few reasons why the fakes would have sought the forest.
"Jin, if that's true, wouldn't we need the Contractor of Truth?"
At Hedo's words, Jin shook his head.

"Protecting Yuria will be too difficult if there are multiple fake Yonas. There are two types of energy, so let's suppress everyone without distinguishing between the real sister and the fake, and then try to distinguish them."
